practice_questions.question_text: Construct Python function split_names(entries) returning two parallel lists of surnames and firstnames. Each input string has exactly one comma separating surname from firstnames; strip surrounding spaces. For example "Okafor, Ada".
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Replace old collection API with explicitly formatted Python strings. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
practice_questions.solution:
def split_names(entries):
    surnames = []
    firstnames = []
    for entry in entries:
        surname, first = entry.split(",", 1)
        surnames.append(surname.strip())
        firstnames.append(first.strip())
    return surnames, firstnames
